name: Points, lines, segments, rays, and planes
conditions: Do not interpret a full line or ray as having a finite length.

name: Angle types, measurement, and relationships
conditions: Do not confuse complementary with supplementary angles.

name: Parallel and perpendicular lines
conditions: Lines that look perpendicular in a schematic may not be.

name: Transversal and corresponding angles
conditions: Angle-pair theorems require the two lines to be parallel.

name: Reasoning, postulates, and elementary proofs
conditions: A diagram is not proof of equality, parallelism or congruence.

name: Geometric constructions with compass and straightedge
conditions: An unmarked straightedge cannot directly measure lengths.

name: Triangle classifications and angle sums
conditions: Two interior angles cannot both be obtuse.

name: Congruent triangles and criteria
latex: \text{SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS (and HL for right triangles)}
conditions: SSA and AAA do not establish triangle congruence in general.

name: Triangle inequalities and side-angle relationships
conditions: Equality yields a degenerate triangle, not a proper triangle.

name: Triangle medians, altitudes, and centers
conditions: The orthocenter can lie outside an obtuse triangle.

name: Pythagorean theorem and converse
conditions: Never use the Pythagorean equality for a non-right triangle.

name: Special right triangles (30-60-90, 45-45-90)
conditions: Do not confuse the side opposite 30° with the longer leg.

name: Triangle similarity criteria and proportions
conditions: Similarity does not imply equal size or equal area.

name: Proportional segments and midsegment theorem
conditions: A line through only one midpoint is not necessarily a midsegment.

name: Right-triangle trigonometric ratios and applications
conditions: The standard ratios assume a right triangle and correctly identified reference angle.

name: Heron formula and area from three sides
conditions: Sides must satisfy strict triangle inequalities.

name: Parallelograms and trapezoids
conditions: Textbooks vary on whether a trapezoid has exactly one or at least one parallel pair; state the convention.

name: Rectangles, squares, rhombi, and kites
conditions: The kite diagonal-area rule requires perpendicular diagonals; ordinary convex kites satisfy it.

name: Properties of regular polygons
conditions: A polygon with only equal angles is not necessarily regular.

name: Polygon angles and number of diagonals
conditions: These formulas assume a simple polygon with n≥3.

name: Perimeter and area of triangles
conditions: A slanted side is not automatically the perpendicular height.

name: Areas of quadrilaterals and trapezoids
conditions: Nonparallel side lengths must not be substituted for the height.

name: Areas of regular polygons and apothems
conditions: Formula A=Pa/2 assumes the apothem of a tangential regular polygon.

name: Composite plane figures and removed regions
conditions: Perimeter needs a separate boundary trace; area subtraction alone does not give perimeter.

name: Similarity scaling: perimeters and areas
conditions: A ratio of areas must not be used directly as the side ratio.

name: Circle vocabulary, chords, diameters, and tangents
conditions: A secant passes through two circle points; a tangent touches at exactly one point.

name: Central angles, arc length, and circumference
conditions: If the angle is supplied in radians, use L=rθ instead.

name: Inscribed angles, secants, and intersecting chords
conditions: The half-arc theorem requires the vertex on the circle; interior intersection uses an arc sum.

name: Circle sectors and circular segments
conditions: The sector-minus-triangle expression is for the minor segment when 0°<θ≤180°.

name: Tangency, secant lengths, and chord properties
conditions: For tangent length, external point distance must exceed radius.

name: Cyclic quadrilaterals and Ptolemy theorem
conditions: Not every quadrilateral is cyclic.

name: Inscribed and circumscribed polygons
conditions: For a regular n-gon, side and apothem formulas must use the same n and circle.

name: Loci and geometric constructions
conditions: A construction solves only the stated conditions; an extra constraint may eliminate some points.

name: Translations, rotations, reflections, dilations
conditions: A dilation with scale other than ±1 does not preserve area.

name: Surveying-style distances and indirect measurements
conditions: Sloping-ground distances cannot be substituted for horizontal distances without adjustment.

name: Angle bisector theorem
conditions: Angle bisector from vertex A of a nondegenerate triangle.

name: Regular polygon apothem
conditions: Regular n-gon, n at least 3, with side length s.

name: Inscribed angle theorem
conditions: Vertex P lies on the circle, and the chosen intercepted arc excludes P.

name: Minor circular segment area
conditions: Angle theta in radians, 0<theta<=pi, minor segment only.

name: Tangent–secant theorem
conditions: Exterior point P; A near intersection, B far intersection of a secant.

name: Cyclic supplementary angles
conditions: All four quadrilateral vertices must lie on a circle.

name: Angle of elevation
conditions: Flat ground, horizontal distance D, no instrument or target offset.
